purpose: Outcome-blind assignment of APBP candidate breeding sites to uniquely resolvable SCAR ADD land-polygon anchors using an API-efficient nearest-distance procedure.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: No population trend, abundance change, colonization, extinction or replacement outcome may be read.

scar_add.dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

provenance.v3_geometric_result: 94/122 exact unique land matches; 120/122 within 500 m; all 122 within 1000 m. Fixed-radius neighborhoods often contain nearby islets/mainland and therefore cannot define a unique focal land polygon.
provenance.v4_operational_result: Exact-first 1 m binary search was scientifically valid but operationally nonviable on the public service because rate limiting left the run in progress for more than 9 hours.
provenance.v5_change_only: Retain exact-first nearest-unique logic, but bracket exact misses with sparse radii and resolve the first land distance to 25 m precision with explicit throttling.

assignment_rule.step_1_exact: Query distance 0. Exactly one FID -> assigned_exact. More than one -> unresolved ambiguous_exact.
assignment_rule.step_2_bracket: For exact misses, query 500, 1000, 2000 and 5000 m sequentially until the first non-empty result. The previous empty radius and first non-empty radius define the search bracket.
assignment_rule.step_3_refine: Bisect the bracket until its width is <=25 m, maintaining a lower no-match bound and upper match bound.
assignment_rule.step_4_assign: At the upper match bound, assign only if exactly one FID is returned. More than one -> unresolved ambiguous_nearest_band.

acceptance_rule.rule: Pass only if >=95% receive one unique FID anchor and <=5% remain unresolved.

boundary: Assigned FID is only a geometric anchor.
Raw FID is not yet interpreted as biological island identity or island area.
Gate 1B must separately audit raw-FID-to-landmass meaning before island/mainland classification.
No demographic response is joined in Gate 1A.
